title: CIA-UAP-007, Current Status Of Unidentified Flying Objects (UFO) Project.
doc_notes: This is a 1953 CIA memorandum summarizing the status of U.S. and foreign government UFO projects, containing several redacted sections.

incidents.summary: Canadian Department of Transport investigation into UFOs led by Wilbur B. Smith.
incidents.quote: Wilbur B. Smith of the Canadian Department of Transport had been conducting saucer investigations for three years before 1952

incidents.summary: Reports of flying saucer experiments being conducted at A. V. Roe, Ltd., Toronto.
incidents.quote: experiments on a flying saucer are actually being conducted at A. V. Roe, Ltd., Toronto
